Lena T: Quick triage: PKGPartner's ETA shifted +11 days due to a customs hold in NL. They're asking to reassign a subset of our reserved capacity to a different fulfillment center (EU-central) to meet commitments. Can EU-central pick the same GPU SKUs?
Marco D: EU-central has same SKU family but different lot numbers, depends on firmware revision. Need confirmation on compatibility.
PKGPartner: We can divert 20 units to EU-central DC-3. Those units are from lot L-2108; you'll need to accept firmware swap or we can flash to match. We can do flash but it adds 6h to prep.
Hannah F: Are impacted reservations visible?
Lena T: res_72100..res_72104 are in hold for shipment from NL. If we divert we'll need to update those reservations to point to DC-3 pool.
ops-bot: Created infra ticket INF-91233 to map lot compatibility.
Marco D: I'll run compatibility matrix:
```
compat check --from L-2108 --to DC-3
```
PKGPartner: If you accept cross-flash, we can expedite and shave 4 days off ETA vs full crossdock. We'll absorb partial expedite cost if Redwood agrees to 3% of unit price.
Lena T: Finance needs to sign off on spend. Who owns the decision?
Marco D: I'll validate compatibility and flag any security concerns. If flashing is safe, propose we accept partner's 3% expedite.
Hannah F: Customer impact: these reservations back Enterprise PO PO-3309; Sales wants to approve credits threshold before we accept partner fee.
Lena T: Ok leave decision pending compatibility. Marco update in 2 hours.
Marco D: compatibility OK, flash safe, no secure enclave changes. Recommend accept partner flash and update reservations to DC-3.
PKGPartner: We'll queue flash and push updated ASN. Need final confirmation.
Lena T: Confirmed. Proceed with flash and redirect res_72100..res_72104 to DC-3. Ops: please run reconcile after ASN.
ops-bot: Reservation update scheduled: res_72100,res_72101,res_72102,res_72103,res_72104 -> pool DC-3 (job 7708).
Hannah F: I'll inform Sales and request finance approval for the 3% fee.
Lena T: thanks. Closing thread once ASN received.
